mirror_rule_corrected: G'[b_src][b_dst] = G[mir(b_src)][mir(b_dst)]  (mirror only; an edge A->B mirrors to mir(A)->mir(B))
deviation_note: the preregistered rule composes mirroring with a direction reversal; for a block whose destination is already the mirror of its source (LF->RF, LM->RM, LH->RH and their reverses) it compares the block with itself and can never report asymmetry. See DEVIATIONS.md. Both indices are reported; the corrected rule is the primary bilateral-symmetry number.
asym_index_definition: sum|G-G'| / sum(G+G') over the whole 9x9 block matrix
